images.name: 01_dry_street
images.prompt: Top-down satellite photograph, daytime, realistic, of a downtown riverside street block in an older US East Coast city with brick warehouses. The road is completely dry, normal traffic, no water anywhere.

images.name: 02_flood_shallow
images.prompt: Top-down satellite photograph, daytime, realistic, of a downtown riverside street block in an older US East Coast city with brick warehouses. A thin sheet of shallow floodwater, a few inches deep, covers the road; cars are still driving through it and lane markings are visible through the water.

images.name: 03_flood_knee
images.prompt: Top-down satellite photograph, daytime, realistic, of a downtown riverside street block in an older US East Coast city with brick warehouses. Brown floodwater about knee deep covers the whole street; parked cars have water up to their wheel hubs; lane markings are no longer visible.

images.name: 04_flood_deep
images.prompt: Top-down satellite photograph, daytime, realistic, of a downtown riverside street block in an older US East Coast city with brick warehouses. Brown floodwater about chest deep fills the street; parked cars are submerged up to their windows and an empty city bus is stuck in the water.

images.name: 05_flood_severe
images.prompt: Top-down satellite photograph, daytime, realistic, of a downtown riverside street block in an older US East Coast city with brick warehouses. The whole riverfront block is inundated by the river; only the roofs of parked cars and the tops of first-floor windows show above the brown water.

images.name: 06_building_fire
images.prompt: Top-down satellite photograph, daytime, realistic, of a downtown riverside street block in an older US East Coast city with brick warehouses. Firefighters are responding at one warehouse: grey smoke rises from its roof, and two red fire engines and a ladder truck are parked on the dry street with hoses laid out.
